autoBiddingInfo.title: How Auto Bidding Works
autoBiddingInfo.description: Auto bidding saves you from watching the auction around the clock:
autoBiddingInfo.step1: Set the maximum amount you're willing to pay
autoBiddingInfo.step2: When someone else bids, the system automatically raises your bid step by step to keep you in the lead
autoBiddingInfo.step3: This continues until the other bidder gives up, or your bid reaches your maximum
